title: Tech Note: New List Box Features in 4D v11 SQL
author: Larry Sharpe, 4D Developer, InfoService
featured_technology: Current Selection / Named Selection data sources for List Box

historical_commentary.text: This note documents 4D v11 SQL's introduction of Current Selection and Named Selection as new List Box data sources (alongside the previously sole array-based approach), plus the new Project Forms concept for building non-table-bound forms. List Boxes bound directly to a selection or named selection (rather than manually managed arrays) became the standard, still-current approach in 4D development, and Project Forms remained a core 4D concept for years afterward (though later superseded in relevance by Project Mode's own forms structure in v17+); the note is a useful historical snapshot of a genuine, lasting improvement to 4D's form-building capabilities.
related_updates: List Boxes bound to Current Selection/Named Selection (rather than only arrays), introduced in 4D v11 SQL, remain a standard technique in current 4D
Project Forms, introduced around this time, later became foundational to 4D's Project Mode (introduced in 4D v17, 2018)
